title: CAD Parser – Agent System
description: Parses DWG architectural drawings into structured knowledge; an AI agent inspects, answers, and reports.
subtitle: An add-on for a CAD application that parses architectural drawings in DWG format into structured knowledge: spaces, objects, openings, marks, and their relations. An AI agent then answers questions with evidence on the drawing, runs inspection rules, produces bilingual reports, and proposes drawing changes for human approval.
